home.learnMoreSubtitle: Everything you need to know for {{country}} citizens
home.learnMorePara1: Travelers need a visa to visit India for Tourism for a maximum stay of 180 days in 1 calendar year.
home.learnMorePara2: An India eVisa is the fastest and easiest way of obtaining a visa for India because travelers can submit their applications and supporting documents online. Once the application is approved, travelers receive their eVisa confirmation electronically.
home.learnMorePara3: A valid visa is required to board the flight. If the visa is expired or doesn't match the traveler's passport information, travelers will not be able to board their flight.
home.learnMorePara4: Entry to India with an eVisa is supported at 29 airports and five seaports. This visa requirement doesn't apply to travelers with a valid OCI card or travelers with a valid PIO card.

home.faq1Title: How long does it take for the {{visaName}} to be approved?
home.faq1Ans: Most applications are approved within 5 business days. Governments do not guarantee processing times, so be sure to submit your application as early as possible. You'll receive your {{visaName}} as soon as it's been approved, and we'll immediately contact you if there are any issues.
home.faq2Title: How long can I stay in India with my eVisa?
home.faq2Ans: You are able to stay in India for up to {{stayDuration}}. If you wish to stay longer, please refer to the information at the top of this page to see if there are any long-stay visa options. If there are none, please contact your nearest Indian embassy or consulate for more information on how to extend your stay.
home.faq3Title: How long is my {{visaName}} valid for?
home.faq3Ans: Your eVisa is valid for {{validity}} from the arrival date included in your application.
